title: Existence of a normalized rational tensor comparison
statement: For finite-field datum D, coefficient datum c, separated finite-type X₀, and finite E, there exists R : WfTensorCompletion.RationalComparison D c X₀ E satisfying the target theorem’s normalization, Frobenius equation, and ordinary/completed Weil-pair isomorphism conjuncts.

proof.text: Use constructible tensor/Koszul unit to restrict ordinary and completed tensor to integral constructibles, with invertible natural completion unit. Derived tensor is bilinear, and completion is linear by the reflector unit and its injective Hom map. Extend both bifunctors on localized Hom modules by (s tensor f,t tensor g) maps to st tensor T(f,g). Functoriality on pure tensors follows from integral functoriality and commutativity of scalars; additivity proves the general case. Localize the completion unit and the two canonical Frobenius comparisons componentwise. Integral naturality, extended on pure tensors and then sums, gives three natural isomorphisms, with exactly the prescribed normalization.

Localize the integral pullback/completion-unit square. Every rational object is an unchanged integral object, so it holds at every pair. Apply naturality of the rational completion comparison to the two rational Weil structure arrows to obtain the Weil equation. This argument does not require integral lifts of these arrows. The equation lifts chi to an IsoAlgebra morphism; cancellation with chi and its inverse supplies the inverse morphism. Faithfulness of the forgetful functor proves the inverse laws, providing the required Weil-pair isomorphism with underlying arrow chi.

lean.statement:
theorem wfTensorCompletionFrobenius_exists (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (c : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (X₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))) [IsSeparated X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom]
    (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields c.l c.Qbar) :
    ∃ R : WfTensorCompletion.RationalComparison D c X₀ E,
      WfTensorCompletion.FullProperty D c X₀ E R
